invariants.rationale: The instantTime parameter is generally expected to be a non-null identifier for the commit.
partitionRecordsMap is a parameter expected to be initialized by the caller.
partitionRecordsMap has type Map<String, HoodieData<HoodieRecord>>, which should be an instance of Map.
Partition keys in the map are expected to be non-null string values.
instantTime is typically a non-empty string representing a commit timestamp.
